literal: asma is the honorific word for a name
garwa kakung -- kakung 'male' marks the combined row's gender-neutral garwa
garwa putri -- putri 'female' marks the combined row's gender-neutral garwa
krama kula; siswa is a level-neutral modern loanword like this pack's own wisatawan
sampun (already), matching hotel-basics.i-have-a-reservation's Kula sampun pesen
nyambut damel is krama halus for kerja/work
gadhah is this pack's own krama have (core.csv pronouns-verbs.have); piyambak reused from introductions.i-am-traveling-alone
ibu, the krama word for mother (biyung/mak/mbok are ngoko)
rama, the krama word for father (bapak/pak are the ngoko/general address form)
sedherek (krama for sedulur, age-neutral sibling) + jaler, matching this pack's own laré jaler/laré èstri pattern for children rather than the age-graded kakang/mbakyu/adik

pasangan (loanword) rather than reusing garwa (spouse) -- Javanese otherwise has no word for an unmarried romantic partner distinct from a spouse, and this concept is deliberately not this-is-my-husband/wife again
mitra (level-neutral partner/associate) + damel (work), avoiding kanca (friend), whose own register in this pack's introductions.this-is-my-friend is not clearly krama
